specEditor: Messages for the OpenAPI spec editor (design-first workflow). OpenAPI, YAML, JSON, mock and Swagger are names and stay as written.
specEditor.templates: Names of the starter specs offered by New API spec.
specList: Sidebar list of API specs and its menus.
specView: Toolbar and panels of the spec editor tab. The buttons hand the open spec to existing features: documentation, requests, mock server, response checks and comparison.
